run_f_gold_search: run f_gold to search for a target value in an almost sorted array using modified binary search
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled by running the main block with parameter sets and comparing results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use an iterative approach instead of recursive binary search on an almost sorted array
review_f_gold: review f_gold which performs modified binary search checking mid, mid-1, and mid+1 in an almost sorted array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which searches for element x in an almost sorted array where adjacent elements may be swapped
